C001131.bio: Greg Casar is a Democratic U.S. Representative for Texas's 35th congressional district, in office since 2023. Casar was elected in 2026 as a Democratic U.S. Representative for Texas's 37th congressional district, taking office on January 3, 2027.

C001132.name: Elijah Crane
C001132.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
C001132.bio: Elijah Crane is a Republican U.S. Representative for Arizona's 2nd congressional district, in office since 2023. Crane worked as a businessperson, served in the U.S. Navy and was a veteran of the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan.

C001133.name: Juan Ciscomani
C001133.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
C001133.bio: Juan Ciscomani is a Republican U.S. Representative for Arizona's 6th congressional district, in office since 2023.

C001134.name: Yadira Caraveo
C001134.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
C001134.bio: Yadira Caraveo was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Colorado's 8th congressional district (2023–2025).

C001135.name: Lori Chavez-DeRemer
C001135.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
C001135.bio: Lori Chavez-DeRemer was a Republican U.S. Representative for Oregon's 5th congressional district (2023–2025). Chavez-DeRemer also served as Secretary of Labor (2025–2026).

C001136.name: Herbert C. Conaway, Jr.
C001136.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
C001136.bio: Herbert C. Conaway, Jr. is a Democratic U.S. Representative for New Jersey's 3rd congressional district, in office since 2025. Conaway worked as a lawyer and served in the U.S. Air Force.

C001137.name: Jeff Crank
C001137.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
C001137.bio: Jeff Crank is a Republican U.S. Representative for Colorado's 5th congressional district, in office since 2025. Crank worked as a journalist.
